notes.title: Novena 4th Anniversary News + 🔥 Next Project Information 🔥
notes.content:
[[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37133811/d8dbaaabbe0e5bb822a2411647af5cdfacb737fc.jpg[/img]
Hello, this is H5dev Games.
It's already been 4 years since Novena Diabolos was released on Steam.
We are grateful for the love you have shown us during this time, and we would like to share a few updates with you on our 4th anniversary.



[b][h1]1) Novena Diabolos 4th Anniversary Sale[/h1][/b]
To celebrate the 4th anniversary of Novena Diabolos, a sale will be held.
[h3]Sale Period: From April 27th to May 6th <Main Game/ DLC 44% discount>[/h3]
*This sale will only be available on Steam. The 4th anniversary sale for the Stove release will be held separately.



[b][h1]2) <Novena Mini Theater> Production News[/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37133811/9b5c892447c68441aa1223256f610adbe861b529.jpg[/img]
To commemorate the 4th anniversary of Novena Diabolos, we are preparing a mini-animation series featuring side stories.
Please check out the chatter of the five on our blog and cafe!
[url=store.steampowered.com] https://blog.naver.com/h5dev/223427039697 [/url]



[b][h1]3) Next Project Development News[/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37133811/f7926f05576521e6fef13824aa506bc5d90b66ab.png[/img]
We are currently developing a new project under the working title <O.D>.
[h3]◆ Game Features[/h3]
📌 An <Occult Mystery Investigation> that shares the unique worldview of the previous work <Novena Diabolos>
📌 An <Investigation System> where you raise stats through daily life and plan efficient investigation routes using those stats
📌 A <Communication System> where you can raise intimacy with characters and discover their personal stories

Detailed information about the next project will be released within this year. We will announce the specific schedule later.
The support and interest you have shown for our first work, <Novena Diabolos>, has been a great strength to us.
We would like to express our sincere gratitude through this opportunity.
We ask for your continued interest in our next project, and we will do our best to create exciting and fun games.
Thank you!

메인화면에서 엔딩공략모드를 ON으로 켜신 후 게임을 새롭게 진행하시면 스킵모드 활성화를 할 것이냐는 문구가 뜨게 됩니다.

notes.title: Expansion pack patch details on the 23rd (streaming guide)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37133811/b41103677b0d4998ac6d3bc7d8f83760ea65009f.jpg[/img]

[h2] <Novena Diabolos> February 23, 2022 Patch Details[/h2]

Hello, we are H5dev Games.
In addition to the patch details applied today, we announce the streaming guide for the <Nobena Diabolos: Another> expansion pack.


[h3]■ Patch details[/h3]
[list]
[*] 1. "Ending Attack Mode" is now open at all times without having to watch the first episode.

[*] 2. I added the DLC root open function without clearing the main episode.
It is a function for those who have previously cleared Novena Diabolos, but have lost their save files, so it is difficult to see another route. You can check it out on the "Preference Settings" on the main screen, and if you run this function, happy ending CG required to enter the DLC route will be collected.

[*] 3. Optimized the game. We will continue to optimize it in the future.

[*] 4. Some typos of DLC have been corrected.
[/list]

[h3]■ Expansion Pack Streaming Guide[/h3]

After the release of <Novena Diabolos: Another>, the existing streaming restrictions will be lifted. Now you can freely stream all routes.

In addition, for those who stream the expansion pack, please refer to the guide for smooth streaming.
[list]
[*] 1. Regardless of the extended pack route, people who enjoy guessing and playing games
You can play the game by playing a new game without any preparation.

[*] 2. If you want to see the ending of a specific character,
Turn on <Ending Attack Mode>, enjoy the character's main ending, and then proceed with a new game and enter another route.

[*] 3. If you want to see the ending of a specific character's expansion pack,
After running the DLC Route Open without clearing the main episode, collect the happy ending CG of the main episode (you can check the ending CG collected in the collection), press the new game to enter the extended pack route of all characters.
[/list] You can stream the game according to the style you want.


[h3] ■ OST release[/h3]
Novena Diabolos' OST has been officially released.
The price is 3,300 won, and it contains a total of 25 songs.

Thank you.

notes.title: Update on Novena Diabolos DLC.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37133811/52d579c0ee02b6f047051a67dd341648635f54ad.jpg[/img]

Hello, we are H5dev Games.
With the release of DLC on the 22nd, several updates will be applied to the main edition of Novena Diabolos.

1. An icon is created in the upper right corner to detect the presence or absence of an extension pack installation. If the icon is ON, please note that the expansion pack is installed.

2. If you look at the main ending of each character, an ending page with the name of each ending is added. This corresponds to a total of 25 endings, including the main episode happy ending, the main episode marmul ending, the DLC normal ending, and the DLC marmul ending.

3. After DLC release, streaming restrictions on Novena Diabolos will be lifted. In-game streaming mode guidance is deleted, and all contents can be freely streamed accordingly (including DLC).
Thank you.

notes.title: Announcement of the release date of "Novena Diabolos: Another"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37133811/8903ef18df89ec3e199eee58e7873d5993a01947.jpg[/img]

[h2] <Novena Diabolos: Another> Release date announcement[/h2]

Hello, we are H5dev Games.
We sincerely thank everyone who waited for the expansion pack of our game <Novena Diabolos>, and we are very happy to announce the release date like this.

Novena Diabolos' expansion pack, <Novena Diabolos: Another>, will be released on February 22, 2022.
We have completed the steam review, and we are still conducting final tests at this moment.
As much as you have waited, we will do our best until the last minute to come back with a fun game.

Thank you.







[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37133811/5d2d97e3fea46e79b7ef8dbb0a623fc9b07de9b3.jpg[/img]

[h2] <Novena Diabolos OST> Release announcement[/h2]

I would like to inform you of the release of the Novena Diabolos OST, which was requested by many people.

In addition to the original sound track of "Nobena Diabolos", a total of 25 songs will be included, including eight OSTs added from "Nobena Diabolos: Another", and one simple hidden track specially produced by composer Gong 332.

The scheduled release date of the OST is February 22nd, and if there is any change in the future, we will notify you.

​




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37133811/f9e0c4ea20cad07b558e32c7ca19a1475b0db63d.png[/img]

Voice actor Choi Seung-hee, who was the voice of "Rin Che" sent a congratulatory message to congratulate the launch of the expansion pack.
Thank you for the pretty congratulatory message!

notes.title: released and informati
notes.content:
Hello, we are H5dev Games.
First of all, I sincerely thank everyone who is waiting for our DLC.
Also, I apologize for the delay in the notice.

The reason for the delay in the announcement was that the work that could affect the schedule in the future was not completed, so the schedule could not be predicted hastily. However, I am posting this notice because the work is nearing the end and the schedule has been confirmed. 

Since the last delay in its release, we have devoted ourselves to development not to pass this year, but concluded that it will be difficult in reality. However, the development itself is already nearing the end, so I would like to share information on the Novena Diabolos expansion pack and announce the confirmed release date.

 

[h2]1. Novena Diabolos: Another>[/h2]

[h3]1) Name of expansion pack. [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37133811/6c1453d0fe3085bef0d842ced1a6b783c1b5e853.jpg[/img]

The official name of the expansion pack is <Nobena Diabolos: Another>.

 
​
[h3]2) Additional system[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37133811/b93cc164f78d03cfafe3aac0550d65fd570e34bc.jpg[/img]

If there is a heroine who collected "Happy Ending CG" after installing the expansion pack, an option to fall into a new route will emerge. 

In addition, unlike the main episode, where options did not mean much, important options that determine the ending emerge. Depending on the option, it will be divided into "Normal Ending" and "Happy Ending", and certain options will also kill the player.



[h3]3) Additional characters[/h3]
<Novena Diabolos: Another> adds people who have a deep influence on the scenario.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37133811/c3af50b08a1b0ea332bd552beb7008c9c95e75f6.jpg[/img]

There are characters that are completely newly added, and there are characters that were only mentioned in the main episode. Through them, you can understand the worldview of Novena Diabolus more deeply, and the stories of the Hiro people are also different from the main one.



[h3]4) Seong Wu's recording. [/h3]
In addition to the existing Hiroin and the voice actors who played the entrants and inn owners, new voice actors who will play a total of 14 additional characters (including extras) participated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37133811/96ed177cc0ad8b59faf8588c7020d4d7f683327a.jpg[/img]

Recording is still ongoing, and some fans strongly wanted to record voice actors, including "The Spirit." We are planning to record all the existing lines as well as the additional lines of the Spirit!


[h3]5) CG footage and development progress. [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37133811/b252950104bcd349b21183c93c92529af990194e.jpg[/img]

<Novena Diabolos: Another> will add more than 80 backgrounds and more than 90 additional CGs, which is about 90 backgrounds and 100 CGs.  90% of these are already completed, and we are also spurring the production of CG and the remaining background.



[h3]6) Streaming mode policy[/h3]
On the day "Nobena Diabolos: Another" is released, we plan to lift the existing "Streaming Mode Limit" to prevent spoilers. Even if you stream it, you can stream it without restrictions on the mode.



[h2]2. When DLC was released[/h2]
Novena Diabolos: Another was confirmed to be released in February 2022.
The build itself is scheduled for January, but we would like to focus our efforts on the final deadline through sufficient QA tests. 
As long as the release date is confirmed, there will be no further delay in the release, and the exact release date will be announced later.

By developing the "Novena Diabolos: Another", we are working with the desire to make a complete version of Nobena Diabolos, not just an expansion pack. As a result, I continued to be greedy, and I apologize once again for the fact that the development period has been longer than we planned.

As much as you've waited, we'll try to make it a fun expansion pack. Thank you.

From H5dev Games.

The Demons hold a small festival every winter to mock Christmas, and the Somang Hill Village is no exception, so they seem to be getting ready to greet you in a rather funny costume.



[h2][b]30% off steam[/b][/h2]

From December 23 to January 6, Nobena Diabolos, a 30% discount on steam, will participate in the winter discount!
